entries.notes: cores/threads 8 (16), base 3.3 GHz, turbo "4.0/4.0 GHz", L3 24.75 MB, TDP 130W, socket LGA3647, "3x 10.4 GT/s UPI", memory "6x DDR4-2933", released May 2019 at $2214 -- all read from the Gold 6200 row of the cited per-SKU Cascade Lake list. The memory grade is worth stating plainly because two Wikipedia pages disagree: the summary table on the "Cascade Lake" overview page shows "6 x DDR4-2400" for the Gold 6200 parts, while this per-SKU list shows 6x DDR4-2933 for 6234, 6244 and 6246 alike. Intel's own product page for this SKU states DDR4-2933, so the per-SKU list is used and the overview table treated as stale. Cascade Lake-SP is a 6-channel DDR4 platform, which is why this row differs from every other Xeon here: the Ice Lake and later parts are 8-channel, so a 6234 build has three quarters of their memory bandwidth at the same channel speed, and that gap is the point of carrying it. all_core_turbo_ghz=4.0 is taken from the "4.0/4.0" turbo pair on the cited row, where both figures are equal; this is the frequency-optimised 8-core of its generation. max_mem_gb=1024 and sockets_max=4 are the Gold 6200 platform figures, NOT read per-SKU from the cited row. TDP 130W, socket FCLGA3647 and 8C/16T independently agree with the PassMark record. l3_mb=24.75 matches Intel's "24.75M Cache" naming; the overview table's 25 MB is the rounded figure. launched Q2'19 per the cited release date (May 2019); PassMark records first-seen as Q3 2019. passmark_multithread 17926 is PassMark's single-socket (cpuCount=1) CPU Mark, so it is comparable per-socket across this catalog. PassMark record: https://www.cpubenchmark.net/cpu.php?cpu=Intel+Xeon+Gold+6234+%40+3.30GHz&id=3518

Xeon 6(Granite Rapids-SP)는 AMX와 AVX-512를 갖고 8채널 DDR5다. 인용한 SKU 표가 all-core turbo를 직접 싣고 있어 그 값을 썼다. 메모리는 1DPC DDR5-6400 / 2DPC DDR5-5200(같은 문서). max_mem_gb는 이전 세대와 같은 4TB로 두었고 이 세대에서 재확인하지 않았다 — RAM 상한 판정에 쓰이므로 보수적으로 잡았다.
